name: UCE V3 Core Rules
description: Bootstrap executable rules for the UCE V3 rule platform.

rules.title: Dynamic code evaluation
rules.description: Detects direct eval calls in production JavaScript and TypeScript source.
rules.recommendation: Replace dynamic evaluation with explicit parsing or safe dispatch.
falsePositiveNotes: Generated parsers and sandbox implementations require manual review.

rules.title: DOM HTML assignment
rules.description: Locates direct innerHTML assignments for review.
rules.recommendation: Prefer safe DOM APIs or sanitize untrusted HTML before assignment.
falsePositiveNotes: Constant trusted markup can be safe.

rules.title: TypeScript strict mode disabled
rules.description: Detects an explicit false value for compilerOptions.strict.
rules.recommendation: Enable strict mode incrementally and address the resulting type errors.
falsePositiveNotes: Migration branches may disable strict mode temporarily.

rules.title: Unpinned React dependency
rules.description: Detects wildcard or latest React declarations.
rules.recommendation: Use an intentional compatible version range and commit the lockfile.

rules.title: Mutable container base tag
rules.description: Detects Docker FROM declarations that use the mutable latest tag.
rules.recommendation: Pin the base image to an intentional version or immutable digest.
falsePositiveNotes: Local-only development images may intentionally track latest.
